items.title: Warriors Get Past UTEP To Pick Up Second Straight Road Win
items.summary: EL PASO, Texas – The University of Hawai'i football team continued its winning momentum with a hard-fought 17-14 victory over UTEP Saturday night at the Sun Bowl. With their second straight road win, the Rainbow Warriors improved to 3-6 overall and 2-4 in the Mountain West.

items.title: Heil Named to Midseason Watch List For Ray Guy Award
items.summary: AUGUSTA, Ga. – The Augusta Sports Council announced the Midseason Watch List for the 2026 Ray Guy Award with University of Hawai'i freshman Gehrig Heil making the list. Named for football's premier punter, the Ray Guy Award honors the nation's top collegiate punter in the Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS).

items.title: Warriors Rekindle Rivalry WIth Road Contest At UTEP
items.summary: HONOLULU – After a 22-year hiatus, the University of Hawai'i football team and UTEP will meet once against as conference rivals when the teams face off in a Mountain West contest on Saturday, Nov. 7. Kickoff is 7:30 p.m. MT (4:30 p.m. HT) at the Sun Bowl. Hawai'i and UTEP last met on the gridiron in 2004 when both were members of the Western Athletic Conference. items.title: Legendary Football Coach June Jones Passes Away
items.summary: HONOLULU — The University of Hawai?i Athletics Department and the entire Rainbow Warrior family mourn the passing of legendary former head football coach June Jones. Jones passed away Thursday morning in Oregon at the age of 73.

items.title: Alejado Named Mountain West Offensive Player of the Week
items.summary: LAS VEGAS – University of Hawai'i quarterback Micah Alejado was selected as the Mountain West Offensive Player of the Week after helping lead the Rainbow Warriors to their first conference win of the season in a 56-21 road win at Northern Illinois on Saturday. It marked the first time Alejado has earned the weekly honor this season and the third time this season.

items.title: Hawai‘i Snaps Skid with 56-21 Blowout Over Northern Illinois
items.summary: DEKALB, Ill. - The University of Hawai'i football team displayed total dominance on both sides of the ball in a 56-21 rout of Northern Illinois, Saturday at Huskie Stadium to snap a four-game losing streak.

items.title: Hawai'i Takes On Northern Illinois In First-Ever Meeting
items.summary: HONOLULU – The University of Hawai'i football team steps out of league play for a nonconference road game at Arizona State of the Big 12 on Saturday, Oct. 10. Kickoff is 7:30 p.m. MT (4:30 p.m. HT) at Mountain America Stadium. Hawai'i and Arizona State will meet for the eighth time ever and for first time since 2006. This is the first time since 1958 that the two teams will play in Tempe.

items.title: Warriors Surrender Halftime Lead in 21-10 loss to New Mexico
items.summary: HONOLULU — The University of Hawai'i football team saw an upset opportunity slip out of the Rainbow Warriors' grasp in the fourth quarter of a 21-10 Mountain West Conference loss to New Mexico on Saturday at the Clarence T.C. Ching Complex.

items.title: Rainbow Warriors Face New Mexico On Homecoming Week
items.summary: HONOLULU – The University of Hawai'i football team takes on New Mexico in a Homecoming matchup, Saturday, Oct. 17 at Clarence T.C. Ching Complex. Kickoff is 4:30 p.m. and the game will be broadcast nationally on FS1. The Rainbow Warriors look to get back in the win column after dropping their last three contests with two of the setbacks coming on the road. items.title: Warriors Fall to Sun Devils, 30-12
items.summary: TEMPE, Ariz. – The University of Hawai'i football team dropped its third straight game, falling 30-12 Saturday night in a nonconference contest at Arizona State.
